title: Post-Quantum 2-of-3 Threshold & PocketBase Collections UI

Strict node-level write authorization verifying owner & authorized editor ACL signatures
PocketBase-style dashboard UI with Collections sidebar, dynamic schema fields, and lockbox visualizer
Offline zero-dependency pure JS SVG QR Code generator for node Reticulum (RNode) destination address
SDK app-to-node schema handshake (client.ensureCollection) for dynamic collection & field declaration
Node operator Abuse Blacklist to block abusive identities and Free Whitelist for sat-exempt storage
Data owner designation of custom storage node RNode addresses or random auto-quorum selection
